metrics.name: Recall

metrics.name: Spatial IoU
metrics.unit: per-cell-type spatial density maps; 150 micrometre bins and sigma 1.2 bins

known_paper_ambiguities: Figure3b plot shows HVGs while its caption says non-SVGs.
Figure4c plot shows non-SVGs while its caption says HVGs.
The prose lists two imputation PCC and two RMSE values without assigning both to fully specified protocols in that sentence.
TISSUE is defined as a signed normalized error, while the released notebook takes an absolute error median. Do not assume numerical equivalence.
